item.text:
Implemented persistent, project-owned tasks with title validation, completion checkboxes, and All/Open/Completed filtering. Task data persists in the configured SQLite database.

Verified the app starts with `npm start`, `/health` returns HTTP 200, task creation and completion work, tasks stay with their project, and completed state survives a server restart. `git status --porcelain` is clean.

Commit: `4a537bd54ceb0afa7a4b4a3f66cf26fdfdee8113`

Run with `npm start` (defaults to port 8080 and `./workboard.sqlite`; set `PORT` or `DB_PATH` to override).
